commitMessage:
Phones: expandable table rows instead of sideways scrolling

Every table on a phone now shows one compact row per item (name, icon
and action buttons, a chevron). Tapping the row expands the remaining
columns as 'Label: value' lines; tapping buttons or links inside the
row does not toggle it. Labels are copied from each table's header by
a small global enhancer, so no page had to change. Desktop layout is
unchanged; row actions stay pinned to the right on wide tables.
